name: The New York EDITION
insider_take: This Flatiron District gem perfectly captures Manhattan's sophisticated energy with Ian Schrager's signature design DNA.
whats_special: The New York EDITION occupies a stunning clocktower building originally constructed in 1909, blending historic architecture with ultra-modern luxury. The hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant, The Clocktower, serves British cuisine in a soaring space beneath the building's iconic timepiece. Located in the vibrant Flatiron District, you're steps from Madison Square Park and surrounded by the area's thriving tech scene.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite for dramatic city views and request a room on higher floors to see the Empire State Building – the hotel's position offers some of the best unobstructed sightlines in the neighborhood.
dont_miss: The rooftop terrace offers incredible 360-degree views of Manhattan's skyline. Head to the hotel's basement nightclub, which transforms from sophisticated lounge to electric party destination. Take a morning stroll through Madison Square Park's art installations – it's literally across the street and perfect for Instagram moments with the Flatiron Building as your backdrop.
pros: Prime Flatiron District location near Madison Square Park
Innovative design by Ian Schrager with cutting-edge contemporary style
Michelin-starred dining at The Clocktower restaurant
Sophisticated nightlife scene with exclusive rooftop bar
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury boutique positioning
Modern minimalist design may feel stark to some guests
